metaTitle: Woodstock Deck and Fence | 2026 Award Winner
metaDescription: Woodstock Deck and Fence won our 2026 Deck Building award for Woodstock, Ontario. 600+ builds, 5-year warranty, permits pulled for every job.
summary: Woodstock Deck and Fence builds custom decks and fences for homeowners across Woodstock, Ingersoll and Tillsonburg in Oxford County. With over 600 completed builds, the company backs every project with a 5-year workmanship warranty and pulls all required permits.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Woodstock Deck and Fence builds decks in cedar, composite and pressure-treated wood, plus deck restoration, and installs vinyl, wood, steel decorative and chain-link fences. Offering both deck building and a full range of fence types under one company lets homeowners plan a coordinated backyard project rather than hiring separate contractors.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company describes specific construction standards, four-foot frost-line footings, galvanized fasteners and premium rot-resistant lumber, aimed at outlasting Ontario's harsh winters. Every project is backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty and the company pulls all required permits, and it has completed over 600 builds across Woodstock, Ingersoll and Tillsonburg.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One reviewer praised the craftsmanship on a new backyard deck build and described the team as professional from start to finish. Another specifically credited the quality of materials and attention to detail on a composite deck, recommending the company to anyone looking for reliable deck builders in the Woodstock area.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The business serves Woodstock, Ingersoll and Tillsonburg across Oxford County. Homeowners outside these named communities should confirm coverage before requesting a quote.

strengths: Over 600 completed deck and fence builds across Oxford County.
States specific construction standards, including four-foot frost-line footings and galvanized fasteners, built for harsh winters.
Backs every project with a 5-year workmanship warranty.
Pulls all required building permits as part of the project.
Covers both deck building and a full range of fence types under one company.
considerations: Best suited to full deck or fence builds rather than very small repair jobs; ask if minimum project size applies.
Composite decking costs more upfront than pressure-treated wood, so ask for a side-by-side material comparison.
Construction is weather-dependent, so expect scheduling to concentrate in warmer months and permit timelines to add lead time.
Not a fit if you need concrete or masonry retaining work alongside your deck or fence; this business is wood and fence-focused.
bestFor: Homeowners planning a new deck build in cedar, composite or pressure-treated wood
Anyone installing a new vinyl, wood, steel or chain-link fence
Oxford County homeowners wanting a company that handles the permit process
Properties needing both a deck and matching fence built together
questionsToAsk: Does the quote include permit application, or is that a separate cost?
Can you explain the frost-line footing depth you use and why it matters for our property?
What does the 5-year workmanship warranty cover, and what would be considered normal wear?
For a combined deck and fence project, can materials and finish be coordinated to match?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: Woodstock Deck and Fence was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top deck builder serving Woodstock, Ontario, based on public services, reviews and build history, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.q: How many projects have they completed?
faq.a: The company states it has completed over 600 builds across Woodstock, Ingersoll and Tillsonburg.

faq.q: Do they pull permits for the homeowner?
faq.a: Yes, the company states it pulls all required permits as part of its process.

faq.q: What fence types do they install?
faq.a: Vinyl, wood, steel decorative and chain-link fences, alongside their deck building services.
